GenAiFunction.description: Returns a Case detail view (priority, status, SLA timer, account, contact, owner, description, related knowledge articles) rendered as the Case Detail HXL widget. Accepts a Case number (e.g. "00001025"), a case subject, OR a 15/18-char Case Id in caseRef; it resolves numbers and subjects on its own, so pass whatever the user said and do not ask the user for an Id first.
